:::{#exr-derive-bernoulli-score}
#### Score function of a Bernoulli variable

Derive the score function for a single Bernoulli random variable $X$.
In other words, differentiate the log-likelihood of
a single Bernoulli random variable $X$
with respect to the event probability parameter $\prob$.
Simplify as much as possible.

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-derive-bernoulli-score}

With $n = 1$, @sol-bernoulli-loglik-one-group gives
$\loglik = x \logf{\prob} + (1 - x) \logf{1 - \prob}$, so:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\score
&\eqdef \deriv{\prob} \loglik
&& \text{(definition of the score)}\\
&= \deriv{\prob} \paren{x \logf{\prob} + (1 - x) \logf{1 - \prob}}
&& \text{(Bernoulli log-likelihood)}\\
&= \deriv{\prob} \paren{x \logf{\prob}} + \deriv{\prob} \paren{(1 - x) \logf{1 - \prob}}
&& \text{(linearity of differentiation)}\\
&= x \deriv{\prob} \logf{\prob} + (1 - x) \deriv{\prob} \logf{1 - \prob}
&& \text{(constant multiple rule)}\\
&= x \frac{1}{\prob} + (1 - x) \deriv{\prob} \logf{1 - \prob}
&& \text{(derivative of $\log$)}\\
&= x \frac{1}{\prob} + (1 - x) \frac{1}{1 - \prob} \deriv{\prob}(1 - \prob)
&& \text{(chain rule)}
\end{aligned}
$$

The inner derivative is:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\deriv{\prob}(1 - \prob)
&= \deriv{\prob} 1 - \deriv{\prob} \prob
&& \text{(linearity of differentiation)}\\
&= 0 - \deriv{\prob} \prob
&& \text{(derivative of a constant)}\\
&= 0 - 1
&& \text{(derivative of $\prob$ with respect to itself)}\\
&= -1
&& \text{(subtract)}
\end{aligned}
$$

Substituting the inner derivative back in:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\score
&= x \frac{1}{\prob} + (1 - x) \frac{1}{1 - \prob} (-1)
&& \text{(inner derivative is $-1$)}\\
&= x \frac{1}{\prob} - (1 - x) \frac{1}{1 - \prob}
&& \text{(multiply by $-1$)}\\
&= \frac{x}{\prob} - \frac{1 - x}{1 - \prob}
&& \text{(multiply)}\\
&= \frac{x(1 - \prob)}{\prob(1 - \prob)} - \frac{(1 - x)\prob}{\prob(1 - \prob)}
&& \text{(write both terms over the common denominator)}\\
&= \frac{x(1 - \prob) - (1 - x)\prob}{\prob(1 - \prob)}
&& \text{(combine the fractions)}\\
&= \frac{x - x\prob - \prob + x\prob}{\prob(1 - \prob)}
&& \text{(expand the numerator)}\\
&= \frac{x - \prob}{\prob(1 - \prob)}
&& \text{(cancel $x\prob$)}\\
&= \frac{x - \E{X}}{\prob(1 - \prob)}
&& \text{($\E{X} = \prob$)}\\
&= \frac{x - \E{X}}{\Var{X}}
&& \text{($\Var{X} = \prob(1 - \prob)$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
